description: Craft Agents' cask, Codewhale's and Octomind's tap formulae, and Momentic's Mo from npm, on macOS, installed and not run.
why: Craft Agents has two witnesses, its bundle id and its cask token, so must_contain names both, for 13's reason: must_find alone would pass with either broken. Codewhale and Octomind are not run, so each formula token is its agent's only witness, and must_contain pins the brew row; each token is a value only while homebrew-core and homebrew-cask have none of the same name, which setup.sh asserts before tapping. Mo is not run either, so npm's `qa` is its only witness, and must_contain pins the package row. claude-code and claude-desktop are forbidden because Craft Agents embeds the Claude Agent SDK and its native `claude` binary, pi because it embeds the Pi SDK, and deepseek-harness because Codewhale started as deepseek-tui and defaults to DeepSeek's models.
known_gaps: Craft Agents' own installer, install-app.sh, unzips the same app into /Applications and creates ~/.craft-agent; that directory is read on Linux, in 116-linux-craft-agents.
Octomind's tap ships Apple silicon builds only, so an Intel Mac has no Homebrew route to it.
